blocks.text: Columbus's Most Trusted Residential Roof Replacement Contractors
Residential Roof Replacement in Columbus, OH
Residential Roof Replacement Experts With Over 25 Years of Experience in Columbus, Ohio

Everyone loves a quick fix. The problem is, when a quick fix isn’t enough to actually solve a complex problem, it will eventually feel like you’re just sweeping your problems under a rug until they eventually stop happening. That will never happen with a damaged roof. In fact, if you’ve been settling for a steady stream of patches and minor repairs for your old, damaged roof, you’re only making the real problems worse—and when they arise, they’ll cost you far more to fix properly than anyone would be comfortable with paying.

What your home may need, especially if the roof is over 15 years old or has widespread damage throughout the surface, is a full roof replacement. This is a project that demands precision and care, and it’s one that always works out better for homeowners when it’s done by an experienced crew. Coldstream Exteriors has completed tens of thousands of residential roof replacements in the greater Columbus, Ohio area in our 25-plus years of service to the community. When you choose us, you’ll get five-star rated customer service and a beautiful, durable roof that can withstand the punishing weather conditions Columbus homes face throughout the year.
Weather Challenges Your New Roof Will Face

Homeowners in some parts of the United States will joke about having only two or three seasons per year. That’s definitely not the case here in Columbus. It’s why Coldstream Exteriors is very particular about the roofing materials we use in our residential roof replacement projects. Anything we install at your home must be able to withstand weather conditions and effects such as:
The expansions and contractions that roofs experience during the temperature fluctuations of summer heat cycles
High winds during fall storms that can take loose shingles off of a roof without much issue
Freeze-thaw cycles in winter that can melt ice dams and push that water through any gaps in the edges of the roof
Roofing Materials That Can Handle Columbus’ Weather

In more than 25 years of offering roof replacement, repair , and inspection services throughout the greater Columbus, OH area, we at Coldstream Exteriors have learned plenty about what works best for our local homes. We’ve determined that our customers get the best all-around value from architectural asphalt shingles—a lightweight material that, when properly installed, can handle the heavy load of Columbus’ year-round weather effects. We’ll explain more during your roof replacement consultation, but you can expect to receive an asphalt shingle roof with:
Style – We source all of our asphalt shingles from industry-leading brands, giving you a large selection and an easy time finding shingles that fit your home’s aesthetic.

Substance – All of the architectural asphalt shingles we install are renowned in the roofing industry for their performance in addition to their looks, and we’ve already ruled out any products that don’t work well for Columbus homes.
Savings – Compared to most other roofing materials, architectural asphalt shingles punch well above their price point and are a great option even for budget-conscious homeowners.

We source architectural asphalt shingle roofing from Owens Corning™, CertainTeed, Malarkey, and GAF, and we will honor these manufacturers’ product warranties in addition to protecting your new roof with Coldstream Exteriors’ five-year workmanship warranty.
When You’ll Need a Roof Replacement

Sometimes, homeowners who think they need a roof replacement get the pleasant surprise of learning that a roof repair will be enough to solve the problem for the foreseeable future. Other times, what appears to be minor roof damage can actually hide far worse secrets, and only a full roof replacement will work as a long-term solution. You can generally tell when you’ll need a new roof if you see some or all of the following signs:
Your roof is at least 15 years old
Your roof has visible patches of damage all over its surface
Your attic is full of moisture that appears to be coming from somewhere in the roof
Your ceiling has water stains and mold growth
You’ve been dealing with recurring roof leaks
Your roof’s shingles are visibly damaged, curling, or missing

We’ll only know the full extent of your roof’s condition during your complimentary roof inspection, but noticing any of these roof damage indicators is a good enough reason to call Coldstream Exteriors and schedule that appointment.
What to Expect From Your Residential Roof Replacement
After your inspection is completed and we’ve helped you find the right shingles for your home, the roof replacement process will truly begin.
Installing Your New Roof
A roof replacement isn’t as simple as tearing off the old roof and putting on the new one. After the old roofing comes off, we will first:
Inspect all of the decking
Replace any damaged wood
Install an underlayment

Once those steps are completed, the new roof can go on. Our crews are trained to install every roof to exact manufacturer specifications so that our customers never have to worry about whether a manufacturer warranty is void due to improper installation.
Inspecting Your New Roof
After the last nail has been hammered and your entire roofing system is complete, we’ll conduct a thorough inspection to make sure that nothing is out of place and everything meets our standards.
Cleaning Up Your Property

While Coldstream Exteriors always takes steps to protect our customers’ landscaping, yards, pools, and patios during our residential roof replacement jobs, we always make it a point to clean up after ourselves before we leave. Even the tiniest metal pieces that could end up in your yard will be caught by our magnetic sweepers. Your property will look as good as it did before we arrived, and if not for the brand-new roof on your home, you might not have known we were ever there.
Schedule Your Residential Roof Replacement Estimate

Tired of dealing with the effects of an aging roof that’s showing quite a bit of wear and tear? It’s time to partner with the go-to roof replacement experts in Columbus, OH: Coldstream Exteriors. Contact us to schedule a free roof installation estimate and inspection.
Need more than just expert replacement? Protect your entire home with professional siding services that complement your new roof beautifully!

A Roof Replacement Process That Works
Frequently Asked Questions About Residential Roof Replacement in Columbus
How much does roof replacement cost in Columbus?

Most Columbus roof replacements range from $8,500 to $18,000, depending on your home's size, roof pitch, and material choice. A typical 2,000 square foot home with architectural shingles averages $11,000-$14,000. Complex rooflines or premium materials typically cost more. We provide detailed written estimates after your free consultation, and you pay nothing until replacement is 100% complete.
How long does roof replacement take in Columbus?

Most residential roof replacements take 1-3 days with our experienced crews. Simple ranch homes can often be completed in one day, while complex two-story homes with multiple roof planes typically take 2-3 days. Complete tear-off and replacement requires slightly more time than overlay installations. Weather conditions can affect the timeline.
What roofing materials do you recommend for Columbus homes?

Architectural asphalt shingles are most popular for Columbus homes, lasting 25-30 years with excellent weather resistance. Metal roofing offers superior longevity (40-70 years) at a higher upfront cost. During your consultation, we show you samples and explain which materials work best for your home and budget.
How do I know if I need roof replacement versus repair?

Several signs indicate replacement makes more sense than continued repairs: your roof is over 20 years old, you're seeing widespread granule loss, multiple leaks keep appearing, or shingles are curling and cracking throughout. If repairs would cost more than 30% of replacement value, new roofing typically provides better long-term value. Our roof repair services can address isolated damage when full replacement isn't necessary.
Can you install a new roof over my existing shingles?

Building code allows one layer of new shingles over existing in some situations, but we rarely recommend it. Complete tear-off and replacement lets us inspect your decking, replace damaged wood, ensure proper ventilation, and install new underlayment. This approach delivers better long-term performance and allows full manufacturer warranties.

You pay nothing until your roof replacement is 100% complete and you're satisfied. No deposit, no progress payments, no financial risk. We've earned our BBB A+ rating and 4.9 stars from 400+ customers by treating Columbus homeowners right for over 25 years.
How do I prepare my home for roof replacement?

We handle most preparation, but homeowners should move vehicles out of the driveway, cover items in your attic with tarps, remove wall decorations that might fall from vibration, and keep children and pets inside during replacement. We'll provide a complete preparation checklist before we start.

Residential Roof Installation in Columbus, OH
The Most Trusted Residential Roof Installation Services in Columbus, Ohio

When you’re ready to install a new roof, you face dozens of decisions that seem overwhelming. Which shingles actually perform well in Columbus, Ohio’s climate? How much ventilation does your attic really need? What underlayment provides real protection? Should you upgrade your decking? Do you need an ice and water shield, and if so, where? These aren’t just technical details. They’re the difference between a roof that performs beautifully for 25 years and a roof that fails in year seven.

Coldstream Exteriors has spent over 25 years installing tens of thousands of roofs that perform exactly as they should. We specialize in professional residential roof installation services that solve problems before they start, instead of creating costly issues that you’ll have to fight later. We’re not here to rush through your project and move to the next job; we’re here to give you a properly installed roof with quality materials, experienced installation crews, and guarantees that actually mean something.
Installing the Best Asphalt Shingle Roofing Systems for Columbus, OH

No matter where you go in the greater Columbus area, you’re going to find many homes with asphalt shingle roofs. The main difference between many of those roofs and a roof installed by Coldstream Exteriors is in the quality of the shingles that we use. We’ve found that architectural asphalt shingles offer the best all-around value for your money: excellent performance, longevity, and affordability compared to other roofing materials one might find on the market. All of the shingles we source for our projects come from the roofing industry’s leading manufacturers:
Owens Corning™
CertainTeed
Malarkey
GAF
In addition to honoring these manufacturers’ robust product warranties, Coldstream Exteriors also backs roof installations with our own five-year workmanship warranty.
Architectural Shingles vs. 3-Tab Shingles

There are several different types of asphalt shingles , but the two that are most often used in residential roof installations are architectural and three-tab shingles. At a glance from the ground, you may not be able to tell one apart from the other if you’re not a trained professional. But when you closely examine each type of shingle, the differences couldn’t be more clear—and in our professional opinion, architectural shingles greatly outperform three-tab shingles. Here’s why we feel strongly enough about architectural shingles to use them exclusively in Columbus:
Durability – Three-tab shingles are structurally weaker than architectural shingles, making them more susceptible to damage during high winds and other weather events.
Aesthetic – Architectural shingles are thicker than three-tab shingles and are layered on top of one another, creating a more eye-pleasing 3D effect than flat-lying three-tab shingles.
Longevity – Because three-tab shingles are cheaper, lighter, and less durable than architectural shingles, they typically don’t last as long on Columbus homes before needing to be replaced.
Perhaps the only disadvantage of architectural shingles is that they cost more to install, but the benefits vastly outweigh the drawbacks.
Why Columbus Homeowners Need Reliable Roof Installation

The materials themselves are only half the equation. How those materials get installed matters just as much as which brand you choose. We’ve torn off countless roofs that used premium shingles but failed early because someone rushed the installation, skipped critical steps, or didn’t understand proper flashing techniques.

Columbus’ weather demands more from your roof than most people realize. Spring hailstorms test every shingle’s impact resistance. Summer heat cycles expand and contract materials thousands of times. Fall windstorms challenge every nail’s holding power. Winter ice dams push water up under edges where poor installation leaves gaps, which can cause moisture damage during freeze-thaw cycles. Your roof needs to be able handle all of this, year after year, without compromise—and only a proper installation can set it up to succeed.
The Hidden Cost of Poor Residential Roof Installation

Picture this common scenario: You hired the lowest bidder to install your new roof last year. Everything looked fine when they finished, but now you’re noticing problems. Small leaks around your chimney during heavy rain. Shingles lifting at the edges on windy days. Dark streaks appearing where moisture gets trapped under improperly installed ridge vents. Your beautiful new roof is failing, and the company that installed it stopped returning your calls months ago.

Poor installation doesn’t announce itself with obvious signs on day one. It reveals itself slowly through premature failure, costly repairs, and endless frustration. By the time you realize something’s wrong, your warranty claims get denied because “improper installation voids coverage.” You’re stuck paying twice for the same roof.
This happens across Columbus, OH every single month. But it absolutely doesn’t have to happen to you. Coldstream Exteriors will make sure of that.
Expert Residential Roof Installation for Every Situation

Many Columbus homeowners come to Coldstream Exteriors with different roof installation needs. Maybe you’re finishing that detached garage you’ve been planning for years. Maybe you’re building a new home and want the roof done right from day one. Maybe you’re adding a second story or sunroom and need seamless integration with your existing roof. Maybe your current roof is beyond repair and needs complete tear-off and reinstallation .

Whatever brings you here, you probably have questions. What’s the best approach for your specific situation? How long will installation take? What can you expect during the process? Will your property be protected during construction?
Here’s exactly what happens:
Call us for a free consultation and we’ll come to your property within 24 hours to assess your project properly.
We’ll discuss your goals, explain your material options, answer every question thoroughly, and provide a detailed written estimate that covers everything.
Our crews will complete your new roof installation with painstaking care, and we’ll keep you informed at every step of the project.
Your project will end with a final inspection to ensure your roof was installed properly, and we will clean up after ourselves before we leave for good.
We’ve installed hundreds of roofs across Columbus, and we know exactly what it takes to deliver results you can count on for decades.

Whether you’re building new construction, adding a garage, or installing a completely new roof system on your existing home, the quality of that installation determines everything. How long your roof lasts. How well it protects your belongings. How much you spend on energy bills. How your home looks from the street. One professional installation done right protects your family and your investment for decades. One careless installation creates problems you’ll fight for years.
